cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved this spot for our picnic. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: More space is approved too. We can move the blanket under that tree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why you pulled away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll stay. You may question the mustard; that belongs on today's agenda. Tell me if I've finally made the sandwiches the way you like.
